title: 📰 AI news · November 8

items.title: Claude Code saves passwords in a project file, and they show up on GitHub
items.text: If you pick "Yes, and don't ask again" in Claude Code, the command is saved in a settings file together with the password. Apiiro found 1,122 public copies of that file holding secrets, including 379 database passwords. If you use Claude Code, your passwords may sit in the same file. Check the .claude folder in your repositories and replace the keys you typed into commands. Free guide "Protecting your computer, code and access": send the word "protect" to the bot.

items.title: French bank Arkéa lost up to $133 million through a contractor
items.text: The attacker got in through a service provider's platform and moved money from the bank's own account. Customer funds are untouched, and the bank warned of more phishing. If a call or email arrives in the bank's name, call your adviser back on the number in the app.

items.title: Open DeepSeek V4.1 Flash breaks into networks almost as well as a closed model
items.text: Vals AI tested agents in a simulated corporate network. GPT-6 Sol Daybreak reached 80.8 percent of objectives, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 72.8 percent, at about $3 a run instead of $22.

items.title: Nous Research releases Arete-27B, fine-tuned from Qwen
items.text: The model was made from Qwen3.8-27B on 53 million tokens. The share of answers following China's official line fell from 22 percent to under one. The model and data are open.

items.title: Inkling 2 Small swears in its own thoughts: 316 expletives
items.text: Vals AI read the model's reasoning logs across 2,655 runs. Swearing showed up in 50 of them, mostly aimed at its own mistakes. Users usually don't see these steps.

items.title: The foldable iPhone Duo now has more than 100,000 apps
items.text: Apple says thousands more arrive every day. Word, Outlook and Zoom now fit the Duo screen. The device starts at $1,999 and shipping has slipped into next year.

takeaway: The thread today: passwords and keys end up where you don't expect, in project files and on contractors' platforms. Recommendation: look for a .claude folder in your projects and replace the keys you typed into commands.
